title: cassipourea afzelii
intro: Cassipourea afzelii, commonly known as the Red Ironwood or African Red Ironwood, is a plant species within the Rhizophoraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cassipourea afzelii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it effective in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
